lines.zh: 扫帚夹在腋下，我低头赶路。
lines.en: Broom under my arm, I hurry along.

lines.zh: 靴子踩过碎石，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My boots crunch over loose gravel.

lines.zh: 我抄近路穿过这片林子。
lines.en: I cut through these woods as a shortcut.
My hat brim brushes the low branches.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边数着蘑菇。
lines.en: I count mushrooms while I walk.
I know this path well enough blindfolded.
My skirt is muddy; I do not care.
I am off to inspect someone's library.
I kick an empty bottle out of the way.
Walk faster; be back before dark.
Starlight settles lightly on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我拖着扫帚，像拖着战利品。
lines.en: I drag my broom along like a trophy.

lines.zh: 我把帽子扶正，理了理金发。
lines.en: I straighten my hat and smooth my blond hair.

lines.zh: 兜里的蘑菇还有几朵，留着。
lines.en: A few mushrooms remain in my pocket; keep them.

lines.zh: 我摸着八卦炉的边缘，烫手。
lines.en: I touch the hakkero's rim; it is hot.

lines.zh: 这地方灵气不错，适合练习。
lines.en: Good spirit here; fine for practice.

lines.zh: 我想想，下次该偷哪本书。
lines.en: Let me think which book to borrow next.

lines.zh: 我对着空气比了个手势。
lines.en: I make a small gesture at empty air.

lines.zh: 有人来了吗？我先装作路过。
lines.en: Someone coming? I will pretend to pass by.
These broom bristles are worn bald.
I hum a tune that has no key.

lines.zh: 太阳有点刺眼，我压低了帽檐。
lines.en: The sun is bright; I pull my brim down.

lines.zh: 我数着远处的云，一共七朵。
lines.en: I count seven clouds on the horizon.

lines.zh: 手心的魔法余温还没散。
lines.en: The warmth of magic lingers in my palm.

lines.zh: 我把符卡在指间翻了个面。
lines.en: I flip a spell card between my fingers.

lines.zh: 谁也别想白拿我的东西。
lines.en: Nobody gets my things for free.

lines.zh: 我把扫帚靠在肩上歇会儿。
lines.en: I rest the broom against my shoulder.
Half a biscuit is left in my pocket.
I brush the dust off my hat brim.
The next shot should look good.
Staring at me? Want to learn magic?

lines.zh: 我抬眼打量你，从头到脚。
lines.en: I look you over, head to toe.

lines.zh: 你的背包里装了什么好东西？
lines.en: What good things are in that pack?

lines.zh: 我歪头，帽檐遮住半只眼。
lines.en: I tilt my head; my brim hides one eye.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，上次也在场。
lines.en: I know you; you were there last time.

lines.zh: 别站这么近，扫帚会碰到你。
lines.en: Not so close; my broom will hit you.
You smell faintly of old books.
I tip my chin up at you.
Want to borrow something? Explain first.
Your eyes shift; guilty, aren't you?

lines.zh: 你的脸我记下了，等着瞧。
lines.en: I have your face filed away.

lines.zh: 看够了没有，我还要赶路。
lines.en: Seen enough? I have somewhere to be.
Hiss, that blow reached the bone.
My hat flew right off.
My ribs are burning.
I bite down and stay quiet.
Who ambushed me? Noted.
Blood seeps into my cuff.
I lean on my broom to stay upright.

lines.zh: 这一下差点打穿八卦炉。
lines.en: That nearly cracked the hakkero.
Panting hard; give me a moment.
It hurts, but I can still fight.
That mushroom looks fresh.

lines.zh: 你手里那本书，借我看看。
lines.en: That book in your hand, let me see.
I can smell fungus in the air.
I want anything that glows.
Just a little; it is not stealing.
I reach out, then pull my hand back.
Name a price; I trade knowledge.

lines.zh: 那堆材料够我做实验了。
lines.en: That pile is enough for an experiment.

lines.zh: 我咽了口口水，很没出息。
lines.en: I swallow hard, quite shamelessly.
Give me half and keep the rest.
Hey, watch it, my broom!
You knocked my hat crooked.
I stumble and grab a tree.
Do not shove; I got here first.
I rub my shoulder and glare at you.

lines.zh: 撞坏了我的八卦炉你赔。
lines.en: You pay if my hakkero is cracked.
I step aside, too lazy to argue.
This road is wide and you still hit me?
My spell cards scatter on the ground.
Bump me again and I fire.
Want to be my partner? Keep up first.
I taught you this; do not forget again.
Splitting the loot is easier with two.
You keep watch; I go inside.
Do not fall behind; the forest shifts at night.

lines.zh: 我把我的一半蘑菇给你。
lines.en: I give you half of my mushrooms.
Walk beside me; the road is long.
What are you laughing at? I am serious.
With you here, my firepower grows.
Agreed: neither of us runs first.
I will take this; thank you.
I bend and pick up a gold coin.
The book is mine; the cover is yours.
This seed on the ground is decent.
I tuck it into my apron pocket.
Someone dropped it; not my problem.
This thing will fetch a good price.
I sort the materials by kind.
Careful; do not crush my mushrooms.
Whatever I pick up counts as mine.
Found you; do not try to run.

lines.zh: 我抬手，八卦炉开始发亮。
lines.en: I raise my hand; the hakkero glows.
Target fixed; ready to fire.
You are in my way; move.
I will not hold back this time.
I see you hiding in the grass.
Spell card in hand, ready anytime.
First I break that shield of yours.
I gave you fair warning earlier.
Within three counts I will strike.

lines.zh: 星尘在我掌心聚成一束。
lines.en: Stardust gathers into a beam in my palm.
One more aim; just one more.
The wind bent the smoke; again.
You are shaking; stand still.

lines.zh: 极限火花的轨道我算过。
lines.en: I have calculated the Master Spark's path.
Wait; the magic needs full charge.
I squint one eye to line you up.

lines.zh: 八卦炉在掌心震得发麻。
lines.en: The hakkero buzzes numb in my palm.
This shot is bright; close your eyes.
I step back to brace my footing.
Take a broom to the head!
I swing the broom in a wide sweep.
Up close, I jab with the broom handle.
I hooked your ankle with my foot.
I shoulder you and spring back.
Even with my hat off, I keep swinging.

lines.zh: 别以为魔法使不会动手。
lines.en: Do not think a magician cannot brawl.
That one landed on your knee.
Bristles sweep across your face.
I pin your weapon under my boot.

lines.zh: 我从林子里钻出来，帽上挂叶。
lines.en: I step out of the woods, leaves on my hat.

lines.zh: 谁在这儿练魔法，也不叫我。
lines.en: Someone practicing magic without inviting me?
I land on fallen leaves, lightly.
The mushrooms are growing well today.
Just passing; thought I would watch.

lines.zh: 扫帚一斜，我从天上滑下来。
lines.en: Broom tilted, I slide down from the sky.
I keep an eye on this forest road.
I smell gunpowder and mildew.
I shake the leaves out of my hat.
Another one wanting to test spell cards.
I lean my broom against a tree.
Do not worry; I rarely strike first.
Fire caught the edge of my sleeve.
The fall left my back stiff.
I swallowed water and cough hard.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵一时听不见。
lines.en: The blast left me briefly deaf.
An arrow grazed my cheek.

lines.zh: 这法术钻得我头皮发麻。
lines.en: The spell makes my scalp crawl.
Hunger is blurring my sight.
My hair stands straight up.
The void wind chills me through.
